newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Spectrum ups year loss to A$12.7 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Spectrum ups year loss to A$12.7 mln.

text.p: Telecommunications reseller Spectrum Network Systems Ltd said on Thursday it had revised its net loss for 1995/96 to A$12.67 million from A$8.51 million.
The retrospective adjustment follows the appointment of receivers and managers to fellow telecomunications reseller, Digicall Group Ltd, in which Spectrum holds 17.5 million shares.
Spectrum said it had provided for a diminution in the value of its Digicall investment through an abnormal loss of A$3.5 million.
Spectrum shares closed steady at 60 cents on turnover of 31,500 shares.
Digicall was placed in receivership on September 16 by Vodafone Group Plc which was owed about A$50 million.
